summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private path-resolution helper, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection after Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests from the spec). Nothing was committed and no tests, black, or flake8 were run; line lengths were checked by hand and are within 120 columns. Judgment calls: typing is imported alongside os and json for the Optional hint; file-read OSError is re-raised as ValueError; non-object top levels and non-list key values raise ValueError.
